case_title: LESLEY BAUER ET AL VS. ARDEN HOFFMAN

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY BAUER, LESLEY BAUER, JOHN AS TO DEFENDANT HOFFMAN, ARDEN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-30-2021 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$95.00) SERVED MAY-05-2021, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT HOFFMAN, ARDEN

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-30-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JUL-07-2021 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFFS LESLEY AND JOHN BAUER ARE PRESENT. DEFENDANT ARDEN HOFFMAN IS PRESENT. PARTIES REACH SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN OPEN COURT. NO APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE NEXT HEARING DATE IF DEPOSITED FUNDS ARE MADE AVAILABLE TO PLAINTIFF'S AND THE MATTER WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED.. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED IF THE TERMS ARE NOT MEET, AND JUDGMENT WILL BE ISSUED. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
ORDER CONTINUNCE FOR PROGRESS REPORT. MATTER CONTINUED TO JULY 7, 20201 AT 10:00 A.M. IF NO APPEARANCES MATTER WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED.
THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. CASE SETTLED. NO APPEARANCES. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
ORDER RE: DISMISSAL WITH PREJUDICE. CASE SETTLED.
